flagged.title: What Is Sociology? The Sociological Approach
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes Ann Oakley's work on gender socialisation and childhood toys to secondary socialisation rather than primary socialisation in the family, confusing core specification content.

mark_affecting.quote: feminist sociologists like Oakley point out that secondary socialisation through things like childhood toys, media, and peer groups, actually reinforces really rigid, unequal gender expectations from a very young age
